## Services & Pricing
- **Curly Cut & Styled Finish** — $100 (60 mins)
  - Custom wet and or dry-cutting tailored to your unique curl pattern and density. Includes wash, deep conditioning, and step-by-step styling coaching.
- **Vintage Styling & Classic Updos** — $125 (60 mins)
  - Authentic victory rolls, retro waves, and pin-up styling crafted for longevity, events, swing dancing, and photo shoots.
- **General Haircut & Styled Finish** — $100 (60 mins)
  - Consultation and personalized haircut. TIps for everyday styling and product recommendations.
- **Weddings, Productions & Events** — Custom Quote
  - On-location hair styling for bridal parties, commercial shoots, vintage events, and theatrical productions.
